description: Land Title Settlement Department - Haragama D/S Division,Kandy Kadawath Hathara and Gangawata Koralaya, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including details about land ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and registration particulars. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes, which cover land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
